ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Librarianship for Latin American, Iberian and Latino Studies] Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This section is for LEEP students. Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis with the consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@illinois.edu). Required on-campus session Friday, October 16. 2 or 4 hours (be sure to enroll in your desired amount of credit).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
